activity_summary: You were not in the shrew. You told John the hour, Tuesday at ten, and the twelve pence, and you said the twelve pence does not come off the share. Cowley did not take a part, and he did not ask which cut stands. John had read The Disguises on the Rose bill. You did not go. You went home for the bran. Tomorrow you are in Titus.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named Tuesday, refused to give up the part, and left.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Said the plot had him nowhere, kept the twelve pence off the share, and named the Rose title.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Left Monday's cut for Monday, and did not take a roll.
